question: On the eighteen already archived positive-duration windows missed by tree certificates, how often does the unchanged positive-slack/minimum-component one-query rule certify, and when it fails is that a ranking failure or a limitation of every eligible shared-pair containment?

frozen_domain.records: Exactly the 18 labelled records in archived_windows.cases, with their supplied residual speed quadruples, rational windows, pair moments and previously verified pair-only minima.
frozen_domain.development_interpretation: These are the target and its reflection used to create the rule. They are never counted as transfer evidence.
frozen_domain.transfer_records: The other 16 labelled records. They are an archival transfer audit, not prospective held-out data; the repository already contains their full geometry.
frozen_domain.reflection_policy: Report both labelled records and the nine reflection pairs. Do not call reflections independent examples; exact reflected outcomes must agree.

frozen_prequery_branches.pair_only_exit: If the supplied exact pair-only minimum uncovered duration is positive, stop with the prior pair-only certificate. Make no selector containment query. Floor-sum counts may be computed only as validation diagnostics and are not charged to the active rule.
frozen_prequery_branches.active_pair_zero: If the supplied pair-only minimum is zero, compute C_0=|J|-sum singles+sum pairs. For base pair {a,b} with complement {c,d}, potential slack is C_0-O_cd. Only strictly positive slack is eligible.
frozen_prequery_branches.no_eligible_pair: If no potential slack is strictly positive, make no query and preserve the failed duration branch. An independently valid isolated equality point is not positive duration and remains a separate control outcome.

frozen_rules.fewest_components: Among eligible base pairs, minimize the exact floor-sum positive-component count of B_a intersect B_b; break ties directly by physical-speed lexicographic order.
frozen_rules.largest_slack_comparator: Among eligible base pairs, maximize potential slack; break ties directly by physical-speed lexicographic order.
frozen_rules.query: Each rule receives at most one compound query B_a intersect B_b subset Safe_c intersect Safe_d on its selected pair. If both rules select the same pair, reuse the same physical calculation.
frozen_rules.success: Containment plus positive potential slack certifies uncovered duration at least that slack by the previously known five-edge correction.
frozen_rules.failure: A failed selected containment ends that rule's active outcome. No second pair, score modification, alternate window or endpoint rescue is permitted.
frozen_rules.no_retuning: Do not alter eligibility, scores, ties, query semantics, case dispatch or controls after any outcome is seen.

frozen_calculation.preselection_projection: Before any component or containment calculation, irreversibly project the monolithic archive to record id, case id, residual speeds, window, total/single/pair moments and supplied pair-only minimum only.
frozen_calculation.component_counter: Use the already frozen strict open-strip half-plane/floor-sum identity. No primary per-lap scan or interval construction is permitted for component counts.
frozen_calculation.selected_query: After both selections are fixed, reconstruct exact selected base-pair components and test complement safety with strict blocking ||v*t||<1/8 and safe threshold equality.
frozen_calculation.postselection_oracle_audit: Only after both one-query outcomes are immutable, test every eligible pair containment. This audit may classify a failed selection as ranking failure when another eligible pair certifies, or certificate-class failure when none does. Oracle results may not change either frozen rule.
frozen_calculation.postselection_archive_comparison: Only after decisions and oracle classifications are fixed, compare with archived physical moments, triple classifications, development outcomes and prior controls.

controls.strict_16: Pair-only zero; preserve the prior two eligible pairs, lexicographic tie behavior, successful {6,11} containment and 1/896 positive-duration certificate.
controls.doubling_112: Pair-only positive at 761/32256; exit before an active selector query. Any old failed selector query remains diagnostic prior work, not part of this active audit.
controls.tight_13: Pair-only zero and no strictly positive slack; make no duration query. Preserve valid isolated equality t=3/8 separately from positive duration.
controls.known_prior_work: The sparse triple-exclusion selector, its alternate-window dispatch, shared-pair five-edge correction and prior target containments are existing repository results. Compare against them; do not present them as new.

cost_ledger.floor_sum: Record all-pair validation costs separately from active eligible-pair score costs, with the same primitive fields as the frozen floor-sum study.
cost_ledger.containment: Record selected logical queries, unique physical queries, base components inspected, complement-speed tests, threshold events/open cells or equivalent exact primitive counts.
cost_ledger.oracle: Charge all eligible-pair postselection containments separately. Do not fold oracle work into the one-query rule.
cost_ledger.comparison_policy: Do not combine unlike operations into a synthetic score or infer wall-clock speed.

verification.primary: Exact integers and fractions.Fraction only; deterministic write/check modes.
verification.independent: No import of primary.py or its floor-sum/containment helpers. Reconstruct pair components and containments from threshold events, and independently recompute eligibility and selected outcomes.
verification.adversarial: Attack information leakage, reflection double-counting, pair-only dispatch, endpoint semantics, oracle contamination, ranking-versus-class classification, cost language and prior-work claims.

scope.arithmetic: Exact rational/integer only; no floating-point decisions
forbidden: new speed, window, core or reference generation
using postselection oracle results to change the frozen rule
runtime, novelty, prospective-held-out, whole-configuration or general Lonely Runner claim

interpretation_limits: All records are selected-reference physical windows whose full geometry already exists in the repository.
A positive duration certificate is distinct from an isolated valid equality point.
A failed local certificate is not failed loneliness; every archived record has positive actual duration by source construction.
Reflection labels are repeated geometry, not independent validation.
AI agreement is not independent mathematical validation.
